title: coelorachis helferi
intro: Coelorachis helferi, commonly known as the Helferi fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia and is valued for its unique leaves and potential health benefits. The Helferi fern has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may provide therapeutic actions such as reducing stress and improving skin health. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
